hook.name: BSTDirectionalWhitelistHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for a BST/USDT pool that enforces directional access control: buying (USDT→BST) is unrestricted for all users, while selling (BST→USDT) is gated to an owner-managed allowlist of authorized sellers. Liquidity additions and removals are also restricted to addresses with the LIQUIDITY_MANAGER role.
